vllm-ascend/ch21-primer-mla.math_clarity: Mixed, and mis-targeted for a primer. The chapter has genuinely good raw material: strong intuitions/metaphors (名片留底 for KV bottleneck, 图纸 for low-rank compression, and — best of all — the 垫片/spacer + complex-rotation angle-additivity picture for decoupled RoPE), and a solid decoupled-RoPE spine that does articulate the killer insight M(δ)=(W^UQ)^T R_δ W^UK is a function of δ. That reduces a one-line associativity fact to a numerical-witness ritual — it obscures rather than reveals. Notation is overloaded (14-row symbol table; dense superscripts C/R/DKV/UK/UQ/DQ), a symptom of insufficient design. Depth is present (arguably excessive: float64, prefill/decode tradeoffs) but the reader-facing insight is buried under code and numerics rather than designed to be seen at a glance.
